newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Televisa chairman Azcarraga resigns.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Televisa chairman Azcarraga resigns.

text.p: Emilio Azcarraga Milmo resigned on Monday as chairman of Mexico's Grupo Televisa SA, the Spanish-speaking world's largest media group, due to health reasons, the company said.
Azcarraga, 66, will become the company's founding chairman, the company said in a statement. His son, Emilio Azcarraga Jean, was named president and chief executive officer of the company.
